Adding conditions on the current token, t<=6 and the first token gets the best result, dev F1 0.35 (P 0.38, R 0.32, mass recall 0.35). The feature seems to track a hidden-state configuration that depends on the whole prefix, and no compact predicate captures it. The top activations (about 0.24) are early tokens right after a q/x/p/f run, but this magnitude pattern was not checked systematically.
